CVE-2026-136918.title: FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() ...
CVE-2026-136918.description: FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() in src/unif.cpp that allows crafted UNIF ROM files to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .unf file with a 0xFFFFFFFF MAPR chunk length, wrapping the allocation to zero and corrupting heap memory to crash the emulator or execute code.

CVE-2026-136919.title: FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad ...
CVE-2026-136919.description: FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad() in src/ines.cpp that allows a crafted NES 2.0 ROM to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .nes file using exponent-multiplier PRG ROM size notation with mappers 53, 198, 228 or 547 to corrupt memory, crashing the emulator and possibly executing code.
